verdict.rationale: Numeral is an API-first SaaS product, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question, but the evidence pack never documents scoped, restricted, or least-privilege keys. Agents connect to the MCP server with the account's existing secret API key, and the TEST vs. live key split separates environments rather than limiting permissions, so it is only an adjacent control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
